source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Composite number is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Classify a whole number as prime, composite, or neither from its' is answered as composite number rather than prime number.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Prime, composite, or neither classification is what produces number of factors, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Classify a whole number as prime, composite, or neither.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: prime number is settled by running 'Decide which jump sizes will land exactly on a treasure number': A jump size lands on a treasure number exactly when the jump size divides that number with — on the item about Classify a whole number as prime, composite, or neither.

intelligence.enrichment: A prime number has exactly two factors, 1 and itself; a composite number has more than two factors; 1 is neither prime nor composite because it has only one factor.
